digest.component_or_area: review-bot Bedrock provider construction and container region config
propositions: The review-bot container has no AWS region configured, so boto3 client construction for bedrock-runtime raises NoRegionError and the Bedrock cutover hard-fails before any model call.
build_bedrock_provider passes region=None when REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION is unset, falling through to boto3's own resolution which finds nothing.

The escaping exception is a pydantic-ai UserError naming region_name rather than a rebar LLMError, so rebar's fail-closed handler does not catch it and the message does not name REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION.
AWS_REGION alone does not set the region on this botocore; only AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is honored, and both rebar's knob and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION must be set because they are not interchangeable.
IMDS reachability supplies credentials but never a region, so region config and the IMDS hop-limit contingency are independent concerns.
The missing region also silently no-ops the review bot's CloudWatch voter metrics, undermining the rollback plan's VOTER_ERROR alarm until the region is set.
